overview: The Santa Fe Hybrid is Hyundai's midsize three-row hybrid SUV, fully redesigned for the 2024 model year with boxy Land Rover Defender-inspired styling and standard third-row seating. Powertrain is a 1.6L turbo + electric motor + 1.49 kWh battery, total output ~231 hp / 271 lb-ft. The 2026 model year introduces a new SE entry trim ($36,150), alongside SEL, Limited, and Calligraphy. Up to 36/35 mpg city/hwy FWD. Sources: https://www.hyundaiusa.com/us/en/vehicles/santa-fe-hybrid ; https://www.kbb.com/hyundai/santa-fe-hybrid/
